adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, the EmbedController#best method (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:8-18) shows that when no topic_id is found, it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` which is asynchronous. However, the test at spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:42-45 expects `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` and `retriever.expects(:retrieve)` to be called directly during the controller action. The actual implementation enqueues a job (Jobs::RetrieveTopic in app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb) which then calls TopicRetriever. So the test is mocking the wrong thing - it expects synchronous TopicRetriever instantiation but the controller actually enqueues an async job. This test would fail because TopicRetriever.new is never called directly in the controller.
